# sreagent_connectors (Data Source)

Every connector row, read-only. An infrastructure connector runbooks act through.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sreagent_connectors" "all" {}

output "connectors_count" {
  value = length(data.sreagent_connectors.all.items)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource key the list was read from.
- `items` (Attributes List) The rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when the API returned as many rows as its cap and may hold more.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `config_set` (Boolean) Whether the platform holds a value for config.
- `connector_type` (String) aws_ec2, ssh, kubernetes and so on. Changing it replaces the connector.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether runbooks may use it.
- `health_status` (String) The latest health check's verdict.
- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `metadata` (String) Free-form labels, as jsonencode({...}).
- `name` (String) Unique within the organization.
